models/policy_model_598.pt.role: RSL-RL actor and critic after 100 initial plus 500 seeded continuation iterations

models/estimators.pt.role: matched velocity MLP and temporal force CNN from the final policy run

models/controller.onnx.role: complete deterministic inference graph with explicit history/reset

scope: Go2/mjlab adaptation of guide_dog training, learned estimators, evaluation, refinement and simulation inference export
limitations: The reward/task implementation is the existing mjlab Go2 velocity task rather than a line-for-line Isaac Gym environment.

Real-robot deployment and broad multi-seed robustness are not certified.
